research_program: Christopher Daniel Pang, PAL. Calculation and derivation with Hearthline.

upstream_argument.description: Levent Alpöge and Claude, 20 November 2026 release

reading_editions.result: For p = 2663 every strict group on the pure real dyadic tower at a positive even twist is zero.
reading_editions.originating_question_or_method: Christopher Daniel Pang singled out 2663 and asked to compare it with 577. His PAL and CLEF methods keep the tower and its local conditions fixed while changing the prime.
reading_editions.proof_inputs_and_release_role: Alpöge and Claude supply the Selmer groups and the prime-window conditions. Hearthline derived the conductor period and computed the norm product and the last circular-unit test. The proof uses classical Kummer theory, the Jacobi divisor, Greither’s characterwise class-number theorem and the Buhler–Harvey criterion.
